name: GRB — Large-scale Reference Database of Flanders
description: Every building on the ground in Flanders drawn by Digitaal Vlaanderen at large scale (layer GBG), with a persistent object id and the date of its version, through a Web Feature Service in Belgian Lambert 72. Read by @nexgen-os/grb.

name: DHM Vlaanderen II — Digital Height Model of Flanders
description: The surface the airborne laser saw (DSM, roofs and trees) and the terrain under it (DTM) over Flanders, at 1 m, in metres above the Ostend datum, through a Web Coverage Service in Belgian Lambert 72. Read by @nexgen-os/grb for the heights of buildings.
